color.note: Four interface brightness themes, Photoshop style: Dark is the default, then Darkest, Medium Gray and Light. One token set; every token carries all four values. state* tokens are the Highlight color (Blue by default); accent-* tokens are app identity only.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Window frame: title bar with the menu bar, document tab strip, status bar, and the gaps between docked panels. Darker than panels in the three dark themes, darker than panels in Light too so panels read as sheets on it.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Dock panels, the tool rail, the options bar, the active document tab. The ground most text and controls sit on.

tokens.name: surface-tabstrip
tokens.usage: Panel tab strips and collapsed icon strips; section expander headers inside a panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: menus, context menus, dropdown lists, tooltips, dialogs, toasts, flyouts. Always paired with border-popup and a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Fill of text boxes, number boxes, editable combo boxes, the hex field: an inset well, darker than the panel in dark themes, near white in Light.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Button, split button, closed combo box and caption-free control faces at rest.

tokens.name: surface-control-hover
tokens.usage: Control faces under the pointer; caption buttons (minimize, maximize) on hover; tool rail buttons on hover.

tokens.name: surface-control-pressed
tokens.usage: Control faces while pressed; toggle buttons that are on but not a tool.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and tab hover on panels: list, tree and layer rows, panel tabs, document tabs, menu bar titles.

tokens.name: canvas-surround
tokens.usage: The pasteboard around the document. Distinct from frame and panels so the edge of the image or artboard reads; never used for chrome.

tokens.name: ruler-surface
tokens.usage: Ruler strips along the canvas top and left edges.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px dividers between panel sections, rows and bars. Decorative: separation is carried by layout too, so no contrast floor.

tokens.name: divider-strong
tokens.usage: Separators in toolbars, the options bar, menus and the status bar (1px lines); panel group borders against the frame.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The 1px border that identifies a field, checkbox, radio, closed combo box or button against surface-panel and surface-raised (at least 3:1 on both).

tokens.name: border-control-hover
tokens.usage: Field and checkbox borders under the pointer.

tokens.name: border-popup
tokens.usage: 1px edge of menus, dropdowns, tooltips, dialogs and toasts; the shadow does the lifting.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Overlay scroll bar thumb at rest (thin).

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scroll bar thumb when the bar is hovered, widened or dragged.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on frame, surface-panel, surface-tabstrip, surface-raised, surface-field, every surface-control state, surface-hover, state-subtle, state-orange-subtle, selection-inactive and the status *-subtle fills.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, section headers, units, shortcut text, status bar text and default icon strokes, on frame, surface-panel, surface-tabstrip, surface-raised, surface-field, surface-hover, ruler-surface and state-subtle.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, icons and values on any surface. Exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3 inactive components); kept about 2:1 so it still reads as present.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in empty fields, on surface-field (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon stroke in menus, panels, the options bar and the tool rail (alias of text-secondary). Active or hovered icons switch to text-primary.

tokens.name: state
tokens.usage: Solid state fill carrying state-on text: highlighted menu and list item, checked checkbox, selected radio dot ring fill, toggle switch on, the selected item of a dropdown, selected document tab indicator. Highlight color Blue (default). Preferences > Interface > Highlight color swaps every state token for its state-orange twin (Isotone orange) or for values derived from the Windows accent; see README, Theme model.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: state fill under the pointer or with keyboard highlight moving across it.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: state fill while pressed.

tokens.name: state-on
tokens.usage: Text, check marks and icons on state, state-hover and state-pressed (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: state-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows in lists, trees and the Layers panel while their panel has focus; text-primary reads on it.

tokens.name: state-tint
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of a checked tool, checked toggle button and the drag target band (the Bezier signature), always with a 1px state-line border.

tokens.name: state-line
tokens.usage: State marks that must reach 3:1 on panels, raised surfaces and fields: active tool border, slider fill, drop insertion line, selected tab underline, the active ruler marker. Highlight color Blue (default). Preferences > Interface > Highlight color swaps every state token for its state-orange twin (Isotone orange) or for values derived from the Windows accent; see README, Theme model.

tokens.name: state-text
tokens.usage: Links and state-colored text on surface-panel, surface-raised and surface-field (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 1px outside the control (inset on rows). Follows the Highlight color because it aliases state-line. At least 3:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: selection-inactive
tokens.usage: Selected rows while their panel does not have keyboard focus; text-primary reads on it.

tokens.name: state-orange
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state. Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-hover
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state-hover. Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-pressed
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state-pressed. Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-on
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on state-orange fills: near black in the dark themes, white in Light (at least 4.5:1). Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-subtle
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state-subtle (selected rows). Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-tint
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state-tint (checked tool fill). Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-line
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state-line and focus-ring. Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: state-orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange twin of state-text. Isotone orange Highlight option (Bezier #FF6B35 heritage); used only when Preferences > Interface > Highlight color is Isotone orange, in place of the matching state token.

tokens.name: accent-stilus
tokens.usage: Stilus cyan (the pen nib). Identity only: logo mark, title-bar app mark, splash, launch progress and the single primary button of a view. Never selection, focus or checked state.

tokens.name: accent-stilus-hover
tokens.usage: Stilus primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-stilus-on
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent-stilus fill.

tokens.name: accent-pinxit
tokens.usage: Pinxit orange (the paintbrush). Identity only: logo mark, title-bar app mark, splash, launch progress and the single primary button of a view. Never selection, focus or checked state. Sits near state-orange in hue: when the orange Highlight option is on, Pinxit still keeps identity and state in separate roles.

tokens.name: accent-pinxit-hover
tokens.usage: Pinxit primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-pinxit-on
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent-pinxit fill.

tokens.name: accent-albumen
tokens.usage: Albumen green (the aperture). Identity only: logo mark, title-bar app mark, splash, launch progress and the single primary button of a view. Never selection, focus or checked state.

tokens.name: accent-albumen-hover
tokens.usage: Albumen primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-albumen-on
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent-albumen fill.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons (with an icon and a word, never color alone) on surface-panel, surface-raised, surface-field and status-error-subtle; out-of-range field borders.

tokens.name: status-error-subtle
tokens.usage: Error info bar and toast icon well; text-primary reads on it.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (amber, lighter and yellower than state-orange so the two never read as one) on surface-panel, surface-raised and status-warning-subtle.

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning info bar fill; text-primary reads on it.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (with a check icon and a word) on surface-panel, surface-raised and status-success-subtle.

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success info bar fill; text-primary reads on it.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on surface-panel, surface-raised and status-info-subtle. Independent of the Highlight color.

tokens.name: status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Info bar and hint bar fill; text-primary reads on it.

tokens.name: caption-close-hover
tokens.usage: Close caption button on hover (Windows 11 red), every theme.

tokens.name: caption-close-pressed
tokens.usage: Close caption button while pressed.

tokens.name: caption-close-on
tokens.usage: The close glyph on caption-close-hover and caption-close-pressed.

tokens.name: checker-light
tokens.usage: Light squares of the transparency checkerboard (16px tiles at 100% zoom); the same in every theme so transparency reads the same.

tokens.name: checker-dark
tokens.usage: Dark squares of the transparency checkerboard.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: Ruler guides drawn over the artwork, 1px, same in every theme.

tokens.name: guide-smart
tokens.usage: Smart guides and snapping hints (magenta), 1px.

tokens.name: ants-light
tokens.usage: Light dashes of the marching-ants selection outline.

tokens.name: ants-dark
tokens.usage: Dark dashes of the marching-ants selection outline (4px dashes, alternating with ants-light).

tokens.name: handle-fill
tokens.usage: Transform and bounding-box handle fill (7px squares).

tokens.name: handle-stroke
tokens.usage: Transform handle and bounding-box stroke; follows the Highlight color.

tokens.name: artboard
tokens.usage: Default artboard and new-document background in Stilus.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface (Compact)
groups.note: The default density. Windows system faces: nothing to load. Segoe UI Variable picks its Small optical size under 14px on its own.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, status bar text, number box values, tooltip descriptions, shortcut text in tooltips.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Menu items, field labels, list and layer rows, buttons, options bar.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Tooltip titles, active document tab name, the key word in an info bar message.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Panel section headers and panel tab labels in the Bezier style: set in capitals (WPF: Typography.Capitals="AllCapitals" or upper-cased text), text-secondary.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Flyout and empty-state headings; the Home screen list headings.

groups.name: Interface (Comfortable)
groups.note: The Comfortable density swaps caption and body for these; titles stay.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The app name on the Suite card splash only (docs/design/components/Splash/README.md).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Cursor coordinates in the status bar, hex values, pixel readouts in the Info panel.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Hex field value, script and log views.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Compact paddings come from the Bezier source (toolbar 8,4; options and status bars 12,4; panel header 12,10; panel body 12,8; field 8,6 horizontal 6 in number boxes; tooltip 10,6).

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: Between adjacent tool rail buttons; checkbox-to-glyph inset; icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; vertical padding of bars; gap between options bar controls in a group.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside number boxes and tooltips (vertical); field vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Field and row horizontal padding; toolbar padding; gap between buttons; property row spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body and panel header horizontal padding; options bar and status bar padding; status bar separator margins.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding (sides); toast padding; gap between dialog groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog top and bottom padding; gap between dialog sections.

radius.note: Small and square-ish, from Bezier: 2px on everything that sits in the chrome, 4px on anything that pops up, 6px on dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, checkboxes, tool buttons, tabs, list row highlights, swatches, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, context menus, dropdown lists, flyouts, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Radio buttons, toggle switch track and thumb, the slider thumb, status dots.

shadow.note: Shadows only on floating surfaces: tooltips, menus and dropdowns, dialogs and toasts. Docked chrome is flat and separated by hairlines. Glows mark a checked tool.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips (Bezier: blur 8, depth 2, opacity 0.3).

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Menus, context menus, dropdown lists, flyouts.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts (Bezier toast: blur 20).

tokens.name: glow-state
tokens.usage: Soft zero-depth glow of a checked tool (Bezier: blur 8, opacity 0.5); widen to blur 10, opacity 0.6 on hover. Follows the Highlight color.

tokens.name: glow-state-orange
tokens.usage: glow-state when Highlight color is Isotone orange.

size.note: Single values; density pairs are named -compact and -comfortable. Compact is the default (Photoshop density).

tokens.name: control-h-compact
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, number boxes, combo boxes in toolbars, the options bar and panels (Compact).

tokens.name: control-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: The same controls in Comfortable density.

tokens.name: control-h-dialog
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields inside dialogs (Compact); Comfortable uses control-h-comfortable.

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Title bar with the menu bar and caption buttons, both densities.

tokens.name: caption-button-w
tokens.usage: Minimize, maximize and close caption buttons (46 x 32, Windows 11).

tokens.name: menu-row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Menu and context menu rows (Compact).

tokens.name: menu-row-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: Menu rows (Comfortable).

tokens.name: menu-w-min
tokens.usage: Minimum menu width; shortcut column right aligned.

tokens.name: optionsbar-h-compact
tokens.usage: Options bar (context toolbar) height (Compact).

tokens.name: optionsbar-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: Options bar height (Comfortable).

tokens.name: infobar-h
tokens.usage: Info or hint bar under the options bar.

tokens.name: doctab-h-compact
tokens.usage: Document tab strip (Compact).

tokens.name: doctab-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: Document tab strip (Comfortable).

tokens.name: doctab-w-max
tokens.usage: Maximum document tab width; names truncate with an ellipsis in the middle.

tokens.name: tool-button-compact
tokens.usage: Tool rail button, square (Compact).

tokens.name: tool-button-comfortable
tokens.usage: Tool rail button (Comfortable).

tokens.name: toolrail-w-compact
tokens.usage: Tool rail width, one column (Compact).

tokens.name: toolrail-w-comfortable
tokens.usage: Tool rail width (Comfortable).

tokens.name: panel-w-min
tokens.usage: Right dock minimum width.

tokens.name: panel-w-default
tokens.usage: Right dock default width.

tokens.name: panel-w-max
tokens.usage: Right dock default maximum when not resized by the user.

tokens.name: panel-tab-h-compact
tokens.usage: Panel tab strip (Compact).

tokens.name: panel-tab-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: Panel tab strip (Comfortable).

tokens.name: panel-iconstrip-w
tokens.usage: Collapsed panel icon strip width.

tokens.name: section-header-h
tokens.usage: Collapsible section header inside a panel.

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: List, tree and property rows (Compact).

tokens.name: row-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: List, tree and property rows (Comfortable).

tokens.name: layer-row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Layers panel row (Compact) with a 28px thumbnail.

tokens.name: layer-row-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: Layers panel row (Comfortable) with a 36px thumbnail.

tokens.name: statusbar-h-compact
tokens.usage: Status bar (Compact).

tokens.name: statusbar-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: Status bar (Comfortable).

tokens.name: ruler-w
tokens.usage: Ruler thickness, top and left.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in menus, panels, the options bar, list rows and buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons on the tool rail and in the Comfortable options bar.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Icon stroke width at 16 and 20px (round caps and joins).

tokens.name: check-size-compact
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio box (Compact).

tokens.name: check-size-comfortable
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio box (Comfortable).

tokens.name: toggle-w
tokens.usage: Toggle switch track width (track 16px tall).

tokens.name: slider-track-h
tokens.usage: Slider track thickness.

tokens.name: slider-thumb
tokens.usage: Slider thumb diameter (12px Comfortable).

tokens.name: scrollbar-w-rest
tokens.usage: Overlay scroll bar thumb width at rest.

tokens.name: scrollbar-w-hover
tokens.usage: Scroll bar width while hovered or dragged (arrows appear).

tokens.name: swatch-compact
tokens.usage: Swatch grid cell (Compact), 2px gap.

tokens.name: swatch-comfortable
tokens.usage: Swatch grid cell (Comfortable).

tokens.name: color-chip
tokens.usage: Foreground and background color chips on the tool rail (offset by 10px).

tokens.name: focus-ring-w
tokens.usage: Focus ring stroke.

tokens.name: handle-size
tokens.usage: Transform handle square.

tokens.name: checker-tile
tokens.usage: Checkerboard square at 100% (a 16px repeat of two tiles).

tokens.name: type-caption
tokens.usage: caption size, for templates that set size alone.

tokens.name: type-body-compact
tokens.usage: body size (Compact).

tokens.name: type-body-comfortable
tokens.usage: body size (Comfortable).

tokens.name: type-title
tokens.usage: title and dialog-title size.

duration.note: Bezier AnimationHelper timings with a cubic ease out. Every animation is skipped (0ms) when Windows "Animation effects" is off (SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation false) or prefers-reduced-motion is set.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press color changes, checkbox and toggle transitions, scroll bar widening.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Menus and flyouts fading in, panel collapse and expand, toasts sliding in 20px.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs popping in from scale 0.95, splash transitions.

tokens.name: tooltip-delay
tokens.usage: Hover time before a rich tooltip opens; 0ms while moving between tools once one is open.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The one easing curve (WPF CubicEase EasingMode=EaseOut).
